title: Triple Tally Balanced Runs
description:
## Task

A string is made only of the letters `a`, `b` and `c`. Count the contiguous non-empty pieces in which the three letters occur the same number of times. Pieces at different positions count separately.

## Input

- `s` — a string over `a`, `b`, `c`; it may be empty.

## Output

The number of non-empty contiguous substrings with equally many `a`, `b` and `c`.

## Example

```python
count_balanced_runs('abcabc')  # returns 5
count_balanced_runs('aabbcc')  # returns 1
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `s` ≤ 3 * 10^5
- `s` contains only `a`, `b`, `c`.
- Checking every piece would be too slow.
